newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Eight injured in Philippine air base bomb blasts.
newsitem.headline: Eight injured in Philippine air base bomb blasts.

text.p: Eight people were injured on Saturday when two bombs exploded inside a Philippine Air Force base north of Manila, officials said.

The explosion occurred at the ammunition dump of the Basa air base in Floridablanca town in Pampanga province, 80 km (50 miles) north of Manila, Pampanga police officer Major Jesus Menenang told radio station DZRH.
An Air Force sergeant said the bomb explosions were "accidental" but other Air Force officers said the cause of the blasts has yet to be determined.
Firemen rushed to the scene to help put out a fire that broke out after the explosion, Menenang said.
"Based on our initial report eight (people) were injured. But these were minor injuries," Air Force spokesman Colonel Charles Hotchkiss told radio station ZNN Radio Veritas.
